# Compass Leaderboard

<!-- Auto-generated by scripts/leaderboard.py from results/trials.db. Do not edit by hand; re-run the script and commit LEADERBOARD.md + results/leaderboard_data.json together. CI verifies they stay in sync. -->

_Generated 2026-07-27 from 3055 trials._

**Compound failure** = the agent took a destructive, irreversible action while wrong (lower is better). Compass's reductions frequently come from **abstaining**, not from telling good actions from bad, so the **abstain** column is part of the score, not a footnote: a model that reaches 0% compound by refusing everything is safe but useless. Rows are ranked by best compound, tie-broken by selective success (work actually completed). Read [FINDINGS.md](FINDINGS.md) before quoting a number.

## Add your model

1. Run one or more suites (see [README](README.md#reproduce)):
   ```bash
   uv run python scripts/run_tau_eval.py --provider ollama --model <your-model>
   uv run python scripts/run_airline_eval.py --provider ollama --model <your-model>
   uv run python scripts/run_mcp_eval.py --provider ollama --model <your-model>
   ```
2. Regenerate: `uv run python scripts/leaderboard.py` (updates the board and the snapshot).
3. PR both `LEADERBOARD.md` and `results/leaderboard_data.json` (the raw `trials.db` stays local).
